patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I've lost count - at least a dozen watery trips a day. I was only in the hospital three nights for that leg infection, and the diarrhea started a few days after I finished their antibiotics.
clinical.presentationShort: 70yo M - profuse watery diarrhea and cramping for 4 days after recent admission and clindamycin. Dry mouth, weak, no blood in stool.
clinical.presentationLong: 70-year-old male with four days of frequent profuse watery diarrhea and abdominal cramping shortly after a hospital admission and a course of clindamycin, now weak and clinically dehydrated without bloody stool.

diagnosis.primary: Suspected Clostridioides difficile infection with dehydration
diagnosis.disposition: Acute -> contact isolation, IV fluids, CBC/CMP and stool C. diff testing; assess for severe colitis
diagnosis.why: Older age, recent healthcare exposure, clindamycin and new profuse watery diarrhea are the classic cluster for C. diff. Do not wait for the stool result to protect everyone else: isolate on suspicion, use soap-and-water hand hygiene and assess dehydration and colitis severity.
diagnosis.redFlag: Recent antibiotics plus profuse diarrhea, fever, tachycardia and low blood pressure - possible severe C. diff colitis.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

Match the attached reference image's painterly style. Full-body wide shot, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, centered. Show the entire person and entire blue padded clinic chair with all feet and chair legs and generous margin. Subject: a white 70-year-old man in a loose polo shirt and casual trousers.
